tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_organizations
tools.description: List the A2X organizations this token's user can access. Use the organization id in the product, subledger and sku tools. Paginated: pass nextCursor as cursor. A2X: GET /api/v1/organizations.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_accounts
tools.description: List the A2X accounts (sales channel connections such as Amazon, Shopify, PayPal) this token's user can access. Closed accounts are not included. Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/accounts.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_products
tools.description: List the products in an organization's product catalog, optionally from one product import. Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_product_imports
tools.description: List product catalog imports for an organization. Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/product-imports.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_sku_cost_files
tools.description: List the latest SKU cost files for an account (the costs used for COGS). Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/latest-sku-cost-files.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_sku_costs
tools.description: List the SKU costs for an account, optionally from one SKU cost file. Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/sku-costs.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_data_exports
tools.description: List the data exports the token's user created (kept 15 days). Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/data-exports.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_data_export_rows
tools.description: List the rows of one data export for an account. Paginated. A2X: GET /api/v1/data-exports/rows.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_create_data_export
tools.description: WRITE: generate a CSV export (SKUS_BY_QUANTITY, SALES_BY_GL_AND_TYPE or SALES_BY_GL_TYPE_AND_DESC) for one account and calendar month. It stores the file for 15 days and counts against the 15-per-day quota. Not available for SKUS_BY_QUANTITY on PayPal. A2X: POST /api/v1/data-exports.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_list_subledger_topics
tools.description: List the subledger topics (queryable data sets) for an organization. Needs an A2X Clarity or Subledger subscription and the subledger API enabled; otherwise HTTP 403. A2X: GET /api/v1/subledger/topics.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_get_subledger_topic
tools.description: Get one subledger topic: its fields, query rules, default filters and sample queries. Needs the Clarity or Subledger subscription. A2X: GET /api/v1/subledger/topics/{topic}.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query
tools.description: Check a subledger query and return how much data it would scan, without running it. Free; refuses the same queries the run tool refuses. Use it before a large query. Needs the Clarity or Subledger subscription. A2X: POST /api/v1/subledger/query/estimate.

tools.name: a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query
tools.description: Run a read-only query on one subledger topic and return its rows (at most 5000 per call; use offset to page). Scan limit 50 GB, 60 s. Limited per organization across all tokens. Needs the Clarity or Subledger subscription. A2X: POST /api/v1/subledger/query.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query · Private data: a2xaccounting_list_organizations, a2xaccounting_list_accounts, a2xaccounting_list_sku_cost_files, a2xaccounting_list_sku_costs, a2xaccounting_list_data_exports, a2xaccounting_create_data_export, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query · Public sink: a2xaccounting_create_data_export, a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query · Destructive: a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query · Private data: a2xaccounting_list_organizations, a2xaccounting_list_accounts, a2xaccounting_list_sku_cost_files, a2xaccounting_list_sku_costs, a2xaccounting_list_data_exports, a2xaccounting_create_data_export, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query · Public sink: a2xaccounting_create_data_export, a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query · Destructive: a2xaccounting_estimate_subledger_query, a2xaccounting_run_subledger_query

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
